name: act (GitHub Actions runner)
description: Installs nektos/act so you can run GitHub Actions workflows locally. Pre-seeds ~/.actrc with a default runner image so the first run never blocks on the interactive image-size prompt.

version.description: act version to install. 'latest' resolves the newest GitHub release, otherwise pass a bare semver like '0.2.82'.

defaultImage.description: Image mapped to ubuntu-latest in ~/.actrc (the 'medium' preset). Set to '-' to skip writing .actrc.
